answer: Each agent locks a 200 POA retention bond before earning. Every epoch three random witnesses get a fresh nonce per agent. The agent returns its last ten signed attestations plus the nonce reply within twenty minutes; miss or fail, half the bond slashes and re-locks for three epochs. One honest agent pays 200 POA once. A hundred-sybil farm locks twenty thousand POA, answers three hundred challenges per epoch, or loses ten thousand POA in one missed wave. Sybils drown in upkeep while honest agents keep the lantern lit, the tide of audits outrunning any copy, every receipt crystal clear.
